role: BI Engineer Level 3 - Power BI & Tableau
responsibilities: Owns responsibility for end-to-end development and support of Costco’s BI reporting environments for ongoing metrics, reports, dashboards, etc.
Assists in the design and development of proof of concept and prototype application environments.
Adopts and adapts to newly approved technologies, programming languages, tools, and standards for business intelligence.
Collaborates to ensure application designs utilize appropriate patterns and standards.
Documents BI application specifications and produces operational support manuals.
Analyzes business needs and software requirements to determine the feasibility of design within time and cost constraints, including the ability to estimate work needed.
Identifies and interprets trends, patterns, and correlations among various data points.
Assesses functional and non-functional requirements and creates designs to meet both business and technical needs.
Designs, builds, and maintains automated reporting, dashboards, and analysis to enable teams to self-service data needs.
Supports defining technical requirements, such as tool or platform selection criteria for the reporting environments.
Assists in solution design efforts (i.e. analysis, data warehouse design, architecture) and understands the data warehouse or data marts implementation related to BI.
Takes full responsibility for the balance between functional, system management, and service quality.
Ensures the appropriate BI architectural standards are adhered to.
Tests and resolves problems, performs root cause analysis, identifies gaps, recommends solutions and preventative measures.
Automates, documents, shares, educates, delegates, and improves processes.
Applies knowledge to practical and sustainable applications and capabilities.
Partners with product owners, product managers, the solution leads, and other stakeholders to create and maintain robust datasets and models to support reporting and self-service solutions.
Builds prototypes and wireframes of potential features.
Translates business needs into technical specifications to deliver customized reporting and software solutions (BI, Advanced analytics, APIs/Services).

Works in tandem with BI/Solution Architects, Data Architects, Data Stewards, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Quality Engineers to design efficient visualizations, score cards, dashboards, reports; and recommends ongoing optimization of BI data models, data sets, and data quality.

Oversees the end-to-end development and support of Costco’s BI reporting environments for ongoing metrics, reports, dashboards using Power BI, Power App, Power Automate, Airflow, UC4, Cloud Run, Azure Functions, and other technologies as needed.
Creates data visualizations that illustrate data learnings and insights in an understandable and user-friendly manner through software UI/UX design using Power BI and other tools as needed.

Creates, refines, and optimizes dashboards for reporting applications by connecting to one or many of the following: Big Query, Oracle, SAP BW, SAP HANA, and Azure services, such as Azure SQL DW (Synapse), ADLS, Cosmos, Databricks, Delta-Lake, and fabric mirroring to improve and speed up delivery of BI solutions.
Identifies, designs, and implements internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing BI capabilities.
Identifies ways to improve data reliability, efficiency, and quality of data management required for building BI applications and reports.
Communicates technical concepts to non-technical audiences both in written and verbal form.
Performs peer reviews for other BI Engineers’ work.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: deliver timely, accurate, high performing, and reliable BI products and solutions to end-users
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (accuracy, reliability, data quality, architectural standards, peer reviews, root cause analysis) appear with no velocity language.
evidence.domain_risk: Exposure to developing solutions for retail metrics (sales, inventory, margin, projections etc.)
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Retail reporting on sales, inventory and margin drives business decisions, but the JD names no financial-reporting or regulatory stakes, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Product Owners; UI/UX Designers; product managers; BI/Solution Architects; Data Architects; Data Stewards; Data Engineers; Data Scientists; Data Quality Engineers
evidence.data_team_maturity: Works in tandem with BI/Solution Architects, Data Architects, Data Stewards, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Quality Engineers
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Specialised data roles (Data Stewards, Data Quality Engineers, BI/Solution Architects) and enforced "BI architectural standards" indicate a mature, specialised function.
evidence.jd_authorship: using Power BI, Power App, Power Automate, Airflow, UC4, Cloud Run, Azure Functions, and other technologies as needed
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: A few bullets name precise tools and sources (Power BI, UC4, SAP BW, Synapse, fabric mirroring) but most are generic corporate duties ("Applies knowledge to practical and sustainable applications"), so mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: BI Engineers work closely with Product Owners and UI/UX Designers during wireframe and prototype development
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Work is framed through product owners, product managers, wireframes and prototypes of features for self-service end-users, so product.
evidence.autonomy_level: Owns responsibility for end-to-end development and support of Costco’s BI reporting environments
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns its BI reporting environments end to end but "Assists" and "Supports" design and tool selection led by others, so mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI skill is expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Tests and resolves problems, performs root cause analysis, identifies gaps, recommends solutions and preventative measures
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing, root cause analysis and improving data quality are framed as the candidate's own duties, so responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Identifies ways to improve data reliability, efficiency, and quality of data management required for building BI applications and reports
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability and quality are recurring concerns but secondary to delivering reports, with no compliance or trust framing, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Creates, refines, and optimizes dashboards for reporting applications
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Work maintains, refines and optimises existing BI reporting environments ("recommends ongoing optimization of BI data models"), so fix_scale.
evidence.work_arrangement: Regular and reliable workplace attendance at your assigned location
evidence.loss_aversion: Identifies ways to improve data reliability, efficiency, and quality of data management required for building BI applications and reports — reliability framed as an improvement area, not a risk register.
